about: Vectors for the x402/exact/hedera pairing of @integraledger/lcp's hedera entry point. H is SHA-256("abc") from FIPS 180-2. The bytes were computed with hiero-sdk-python 0.2.10's generated protobufs and protobuf 7.36.2 (SerializeToString(deterministic=True)) and cryptography's Ed25519 on Python 3.12.3, 2026-09-25; the signing seed is not recorded here. Byte strings are hex unless named base64. The V5 rows give status's answer under the profiles read-status and x402-exact-hedera at the one mark, consensus, asked about the act payment unless a row's query says otherwise.

V2.case: build, complete(ed25519 publicKey, signature), bound, reference, txIdText

V5.case: status for V2's reference, through a mirror whose answers each row gives, and recover from the transaction id
V5.about: Each row's mirror answers but the last are constructed, in the shape of the Mirror Node REST interface's OpenAPI description 0.163.1 (Transaction, TransactionsResponse, Block) and of a recorded testnet answer of GET /api/v1/transactions/{id}, for 0.0.3229-1791145265-469000038 (2026-10-04), in which the whole charged fee is credited to 0.0.802 and no row names its node: latest is the end of its newest block, oldest the start of its oldest block, byId the transactions of GET /api/v1/transactions/{id} (null for its 404), pages the answers of the account search in order ('refused' for a page the mirror refuses). Each expected answer was written by hand from read-status.md and x402-exact-hedera.md, rules 11 to 14; the search is never read whole until a run shows its three facts (rule 13), so every answer that waits on it is pending, search-incomplete, at the search's position. Each transfer of what moved is named by the transaction id and its place, the asset and the credited account (rule 14). The last row's are recorded, not constructed: byId is the transactions of the Hedera testnet Mirror Node's answer (REST API 0.166.2) of GET https://testnet.mirrornode.hedera.com/api/v1/transactions/0.0.11505931-1794955079-000000000, read 2026-11-17T22:41:37Z, unchanged, and latest is timestamp.to of its GET https://testnet.mirrornode.hedera.com/api/v1/blocks?order=desc&limit=1, read 2026-11-17T22:42:10Z; its reference is the one this pairing's reference returns for the payment presented under that id.

buyer.about: The buyer gate's rows for this file's pairings, in the form of buyer.json's rows. B2 is the plant: the document advertises H, the hash of the ATR in B6's first check, and the link serves the planted ATR, that ATR with one byte changed; the gate declines hash-mismatch and never calls the signer. B6 is the pairing's bound check over the payment this file already holds: check(ATR, presented) gives H, and check(planted ATR, presented) declines signed-not-bound. Where the ATR is abc, H is its SHA-256 (FIPS 180-2 B.1) and the planted ATR is abd. SHA-256 values are GNU coreutils sha256sum, which openssl dgst -sha256 matches. Bytes are hex. A B2 input names the account, the buyer's inputs and the time (now, in seconds) its build needs. noSignedPayment names each pairing of the file that has no B6 row, and why.
